import subprocess, sys, importlib.util

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("textmask", "/work/textmask.py")
tm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(tm)

def old_masked(text, name):
    import re
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

tests = [
    ("Fowler Refactoring", "fowler-refactoring"),
    ("FOWLER is great, refactoring too. fo re", "fowler-refactoring"),
    ("short names ab cd", "ab-cd"),
    ("no match here", "zzz-yyy"),
    ("Single", "single"),
    ("", "a-b-c"),
    ("A-B-C mentions a b c and ab", "a-b-c"),
]

ok = True
for text, name in tests:
    old = old_masked(text, name)
    new = tm.masked(text, name)
    status = "OK" if old == new else "MISMATCH"
    if old != new:
        ok = False
    print(status, repr(text), repr(name), "->", repr(new), "expected", repr(old))

print("name_tokens example:", tm.name_tokens("fowler-refactoring"))
print("ALL PASS" if ok else "FAILURES PRESENT")
